The handwriting and context suggest the note is not by Ramanujan. It looks like a referee's or editor's remark, probably by G. H. Hardy, who signs the previous page 'GHH[?]'. So the 'confusion on p 3, near bottom' probably concerns the same page-3 passage, where the stated values m = 5, k = 8 seem inconsistent with the formula for k in terms of [x/m] when x is negative.

The note was later cancelled. This may be because the query was moved to the fuller comment on the next page, or because it was resolved. No derivation, formula, or result can be reconstructed from this page alone.
